query_text_to_image: query the HuggingFace inference API with a text prompt and return image bytes
create_image_from_prompt: create an image from a text description using the FLUX.1-schnell model via HF inference
run_inference_request: run a POST request to the HuggingFace inference endpoint with an authorization header
open_image_bytes: open image bytes returned from the inference API using PIL.Image
build_image_generation_script: build a script that generates images from text prompts via the HuggingFace inference API
